trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has four generated steps: summarize_hop1, generate_query_hop2, summarize_hop2, and generate_query_hop3. Only these four steps can fail.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: The pipeline completed all three hops and returned 24 documents. Hop 1 retrieved documents about Brian Yorkey, Tom Kitt, and Next to Normal. Hop 2 retrieved documents confirming Janet Krupin was a swing in If/Then (a Brian Yorkey/Tom Kitt musical) and that Tom Kitt won the 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award. Hop 3 retrieved documents about Tom Kitt's Tony Award history. The pipeline executed all specified steps.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents establishing Brian Yorkey and Tom Kitt's collaboration on Next to Normal. The summarize_hop1 step correctly identified that Janet Krupin's involvement was unverified in those passages and that Tom Kitt's 2007 Tony Award win was not confirmed. The generate_query_hop2 step produced a query seeking information about Janet Krupin and Tom Kitt's Tony Award year. Hop 2 successfully retrieved a document confirming Janet Krupin was a swing in If/Then (another Yorkey/Kitt musical) and that Tom Kitt won the 2008 Outer Critics Circle Award, though it did not confirm a 2007 Tony Award. The summarize_hop2 step correctly noted the 2007 Tony Award remained unverified. The generate_query_hop3 step produced a focused query about Tom Kitt's Tony Award wins by year. Hop 3 retrieved additional documents. All three retrievals completed, all four generated steps executed their roles appropriately given their inputs, and the final output contained 24 documents as specified by the pipeline design.
